caption:
Prayer shrunk to your own to-do list? You've narrowed a wide gift. (1 Timothy 2:1–4 devotional)

Paul makes prayer for all people the first task — even kings, even the names we'd rather skip. Prayer isn't pushing our needs through; it's leaning our heart against God's wide heart, which already holds everyone.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — whose name will you carry in prayer today?
